_what: ACCOUNT-KEYED CENTRAL REAPER — the one thing in the repo that destroys Vast hosts on a narrow, provably-safe predicate, keyed on the account so no lane's private teardown bug can leave a box billing. RULE 1: terminal state, unconditional. RULE 2: unit recorded done AND its output verified present in the object store, attributed to THIS rental by timestamp. Nothing else may destroy.
never_reaps_on: a `done` record older than the instance
detail: the account census is 26 min old (stamped 2:00 PM ET Aug 2, 2026; threshold 20 min), so it is not treated as a weaker reading — it is not treated as a reading at all, and NOTHING is destroyed. Measured earlier today: it went 155 min stale, a window in which a naive check reads an empty fleet while two hosts bill. For a reaper the danger is sharper than for an alarm: a lane that relaunched inside the gap would have its NEW box judged on its OLD box's state.
